attributes.powers:
For your combat check, reveal this card to use your Dexterity or Ranged skill + 1d8+3; you may additionally bury this card to add another 2d6.

Shuffle this card into your deck to decrease the difficulty of any combat check by 2d4, or 1d4+4 if you have the Arcane skill.
